summary: A مُضْغَةٌ (muḍghah) is a piece or bit of flesh, like a morsel one chews. It can also refer to a fetus in its early stage, resembling a lump of flesh, as mentioned in the Quran (22:5).
lane: مُضْغَةٌ ذ A piece, or bit, of flesh (T, S, K), &c.: (T, K:) or a morsel, or gobbet, of flesh, i. e. a piece of flesh such as a man puts into his mouth: (Khálid Ibn-Jembeh, TA:) or as much as is chewed [ at once ]: (Msb:) and such as the heart, and the tongue, of a man: (TA:) and a fœtus when it has become like a lump of flesh: see Kur. xxii. 5; and see خَلِيقٌ .
